coordinateSystem: Y-up; track longitudinal axis +X in standalone GLB modules

models.purpose: Generic Japanese commuter car exterior, doors, glazing, bogies, wheelsets, roof equipment; fictional livery, no operator identity.
Driver cab interior module: windscreen, desk, displays, master controller, brake controller, seat and side consoles.
20 m track panel: ballast, subgrade, rails, fasteners and sleepers.
Signal, catenary mast and contact wire, crossing barrier and cabinet.
Three-track passing station with side and island platforms.
Four-track major station with three platforms.
Original procedural five-track transfer hub with four platform faces: two side platforms and two islands.
Terminal station module with buffer stop.
Modular buildings, windows, roofs, trees, road, sidewalk and boundary fences.
Selected owner-provided detailed fictional commuter car; Z-up converted to Y-up in the scene; per-primitive uniform vertex colors preserved.
Selected owner-provided detailed fictional cab interior; Z-up converted to Y-up in the scene; per-primitive uniform vertex colors preserved.

Player commuter train exterior (10 cars, nodes car_1..car_10): based on 'JR東日本E231系電車' by own.guest (Sketchfab), CC BY 4.0; repainted to the fictional TOO RAILWAY livery, JR marks removed. Credit in app.

Player limited-express train exterior (8 cars, nodes car_1..car_8): based on '117系 サンライナー' by own.guest (Sketchfab), CC BY 4.0; repainted to the fictional TOO RAILWAY livery, Sun Liner marks removed. Credit in app.

integration: Native loader maps COLOR_0 to per-primitive SimpleMaterial colors. Selected detailed vehicle/cab models use Z-up to Y-up conversion at the scene node; all source dimensions are in metres. Existing procedural vehicle remains a fallback.

provenance.source: The owner described the earlier base GLBs and the new add-on GLB pack as generated with ChatGPT. This is owner-provided provenance, not an independent authorship or rights determination. The five-track/four-platform model was generated by the in-project Python script.
provenance.addOnPackAudit: The supplied add-on archive contained 27 GLBs and 21 PNGs; 10 base GLBs duplicated the earlier base pack. Only 2 of its 17 distinct high-fidelity models were bundled. Its README says 14 models, while the directory contains 17.
provenance.omittedAddOnContent: The other 15 distinct high-fidelity GLBs, the 10 duplicate base GLBs, and all 21 PNGs are not included.
provenance.commercialRights: Bundled third-party content is limited to the two CC BY 4.0 train models credited in the app; no other third-party model, external texture, or third-party URI is bundled.
provenance.thirdPartyModels: Two player-train exteriors by own.guest (Sketchfab), CC BY 4.0, repainted to a fictional livery with original operator marks removed; attribution is shown in the app. All other models remain project-generated as described above.
